title: Merchandise Purchases — Store Returns Desk Schedule for Returns Without a Receipt
content:
This schedule sets, class by class, the terms of **Merchandise Purchases** returned with neither a receipt nor an order record.

| Merchandise class | Return without receipt accepted | Price refunded | Lookback for the lowest selling price (calendar days before the return date) | No-receipt returns allowed per customer in a rolling 12 months | Government photo ID recorded |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Apparel, Shoes & Accessories | Yes | lowest selling price in the lookback, as a merchandise credit | 90 | 3 | Yes |
| Beauty & Fragrance | Yes | lowest selling price in the lookback, as a merchandise credit | 90 | 3 | Yes |
| Home & Kitchen | Yes | lowest selling price in the lookback, as a merchandise credit | 90 | 3 | Yes |
| Electronics & Small Appliances | No | lowest selling price in the lookback, as a merchandise credit | 90 | 3 | Yes |
| Fine Jewelry & Watches | No | lowest selling price in the lookback, as a merchandise credit | 90 | 3 | Yes |
| Designer Handbags & Luxury | No | lowest selling price in the lookback, as a merchandise credit | 90 | 3 | Yes |
| Furniture & Mattresses | No | lowest selling price in the lookback, as a merchandise credit | 90 | 3 | Yes |

**Purchase lookup.** For every class, a purchase can be found by the customer's Marlowe & Finch card or Finch Circle number for 12 months back, and a purchase found that way is then treated as an order record.

### Points of reading

- Only Apparel, Shoes & Accessories, Beauty & Fragrance and Home & Kitchen accept a return without a receipt; for the other four classes the remaining columns describe terms that have no occasion to apply.
- The price refunded on such a return is never the price on a receipt: it is the lowest price at which the item sold in the 90 calendar days before the return date, issued as a merchandise credit.
- Hypothetical example: a Home & Kitchen item that sold at $40.00, $32.00 and $36.00 at different times within the 90 days before the return date is refunded at $32.00, as a merchandise credit.
